verdict.rationale: Skyfire's KYA/KYA-Pay tokens provide merchants with verifiable, signed identity credentials (JWTs) tied to registered agents, with explicit trust tiers (identity-only vs identity+payment, Individual/Organization verification levels) and hard gating when a buyer doesn't meet the required verification level. Docs also describe how this lets sites/bot managers distinguish verified agent traffic from anonymous bots ('never anonymous' purchases, no 403/captcha blocking) and runtime probes confirm the token API is live and key-gated. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs and no evidence of merchant-side verification tooling (e.g., a public verifier API for merchants outside the checkout flow).
